name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
summary: Menara Voidrender in the Barrens asks you to bring her Hatefury blood and a Lesser Infernal Stone. She needs both as components for an enchanted gold bloodrobe.

sections.title: Blood and Stone
sections.body: Menara Voidrender waits in the Barrens for the components she needs. Bring her ten Vials of Hatefury Blood and one Lesser Infernal Stone. The bloodrobe depends on both.

faq.answer: Menara Voidrender needs ten Vials of Hatefury Blood and one Lesser Infernal Stone.

faq.q: Who is asking for the components?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender asks you to bring the components in the Barrens.
The Vials of Hatefury Blood and Lesser Infernal Stone are components for an enchanted gold bloodrobe.

attribution: In-game quest text: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
